Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original aggregate-edition landing background for Reveal Line's Coupa Village, distinct from every individual campaign.
Input image role: STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a new overview composition; do not reproduce its close courtyard scene.
Primary request: a welcoming elevated panoramic view over an interconnected Mediterranean-inspired blue-and-white learning village by the sea. A central blue glass flower fountain at middle-right anchors five small connected districts: a market and supplier square, a garden of gathering terraces, a delivery bridge and harbor, a practical maker workshop, and a softly glowing network pavilion. These read as one coherent inhabited village, not five panels. Small distant people may provide scale, no close faces.
Style: refined warm painterly game illustration matching the reference's cobalt blue, white plaster, climbing greenery and amber sunlight; crisp clear shapes and gentle atmospheric depth. Landscape 1536x1024.
Composition: quiet very dark navy shaded tree canopy/stone foreground occupying left 40 percent for overlaid text; wide village vista in right 60 percent. Main flower fountain near 62 percent horizontally, other districts recede toward the right; focal area near 62 percent must remain legible in a narrow portrait crop. Keep menu space free of prominent people or bright objects.
Mood: bright hopeful sunrise, warm hospitality, connected community. Static art to receive separate slow petal/light animations.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, UI, border, watermark, collage panels or duplicated reference image; opaque full illustration.
